label: More such from distinct-cause transfer and reception limits
description: Sibling of CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-MORE-SUCH-FROM-RECEPTION-LIMITS with distinct-cause transfer in place of the unrestricted principle, which that proof uses only for distinct causes. A distinct cause c of r in x has r; x has r received in x, so limited by x; c's r is not received in x, so not limited by x; hence c is more r than x. With the previous result, 'more such' and distinct-cause transfer are interderivable given the reception bundle and 'what is more such has the perfection'. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (omission models). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
